hotel.name: Trump International Hotel & Tower, New York

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located steps from Columbus Circle, Lincoln Center and Fifth Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located steps from Columbus Circle, Lincoln Center, and Fifth Avenue

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 1 Central Park West, New York.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1 CENTRAL PARK WEST, NEW YORK, NEW YORK 10023

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits across from Central Park on Columbus Circle in a 52-story building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across from Central Park on Columbus Circle, this 52-story hotel is a great home base for sight-seeing.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers the personalized Trump Attache service.
verified_facts.excerpt: including the personalized Trump Attaché® service exclusive to Trump Hotels

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Central Park and the Manhattan skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each room and suite boasts stunning floor-to-ceiling windows that showcase captivating panoramas of Central Park and the Manhattan skyline.

verified_facts.text: Suites come with one, two, three or four bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: with one, two, three, and four bedrooms

verified_facts.text: The hotel has suites with kitchens.
verified_facts.excerpt: our suites with kitchens provide a home-away-from-home experience

verified_facts.text: Rooms are apartment-style with a color palette of gray, aubergine, ivory and caramel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each apartment-style room has a sophisticated color palette of gray, aubergine, ivory, and caramel

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Schonbek crystal chandeliers over the dining table and rosewood, mahogany, maple and walnut finishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Schonbek crystal chandeliers over the dining table and rosewood, mahogany, maple, and walnut finishes

verified_facts.text: At evening turndown, water is served in Rogaska glasses.
verified_facts.excerpt: at evening turndown, water is served in Rogaska glasses.

verified_facts.text: Both Jean Georges and Nougatine are run by Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both Jean Georges and Nougatine are run by Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

verified_facts.text: Nougatine is a more casual expression of Jean-Georges, set between Central Park views and an exhibition kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: A more casual expression of Jean-Georges, Nougatine by Jean-Georges is nestled between sweeping Central Park views and the restaurant

verified_facts.text: Nougatine's menu features signature Jean-Georges dishes alongside seasonal daily specials.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu features signature Jean-Georges dishes alongside seasonal daily specials

verified_facts.text: In the warmer months, the park-facing Mistral Terrace has Dedon furniture designed by Philippe Starck and serves the full Nougatine menu with signature cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the warmer months, the park-facing Mistral Terrace features Dedon furniture designed by Philippe Starck and offers the full Nougatine menu alongside signature cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Nougatine is open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner

verified_facts.text: Business casual attire is required at Nougatine, and outdoor seating is weather dependent.
verified_facts.excerpt: Business casual attire is required. Outdoor seating is weather dependent.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Concierge team personally recommends curated New York City experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Curated experiences, iconic dining, world-class culture, and hidden moments, personally recommended by our award-winning Concierge team

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 100% smoke free, and a $1,000 cleaning fee applies to any room where smoking is apparent.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are a 100% smoke free hotel. A $1,000 cleaning fee will be applied to any guest room where smoking is apparent.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes travelers of all ages, but guests must be 21 or older to check into their own room.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome travelers of all ages, however guests must be 21 years or older to check into their own room.

verified_facts.text: The hotel won Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2024 and 2025.
